W29 "Don't ask me again": no more reminders or calls for this job.

get.description: M30: technicians see their own; owners and managers see all (review queue: ?status=pending_review).

post.description: Approve: the job is completed and the customer PDF starts building (GET /reports/{id}/pdf).

get.description: PDF status and a 15-minute download link. Starts the build again if it failed.

post.description: Send the report link by SMS, WhatsApp and/or email. Each message's result is in `sent`.

get.description: M35: the customer's contact, which channels can be used, the current link and the message text.

post.description: Create the 30-day link, or renew it for 30 more days. "copy" also marks the report shared.
Send to the manager. Photos, checklist answers and voice notes lock.

get.description: M45 Review requests: where each ask stands and what happens next.

delete.description: Cancel a request that is still waiting for approval.

patch.description: M46 Review settings and follow-ups. Send only what changed.

get.description: M45 Reviews: the average, the star breakdown, the counts for each chip and the reviews.

patch.description: M45 Low rating: the private note and "Mark as resolved".

post.description: M45 Send reply: shown on the customer's report page and to the technician. Sending again edits it.
M45 "Suggest a reply": a short reply to start from, in the app language.

delete.description: Turn the link off at once; the customer sees "link turned off". Owners and managers.

post.description:
Step 1 of 3: get a signed URL. Step 2: PUT the file there with the given headers.
Step 3: confirm with the call for what the file is (e.g. POST /jobs/{id}/evidence).
